title: What has just happened?
grammar: present perfect with just / already / yet (review)

scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: Kili has just crashed into the window with today's mail! Don't worry — the window is fine. Kili too… more or less.
scene.intro: Kili has just crashed into the window with today's mail. Again. He has already delivered nine letters this morning, but he hasn't finished yet — there are six more in his bag. Oliver has just written a new song, Ingrid has already read it, and nobody has told him yet that it sounds exactly like the last one. What have YOU just done? Say it before the moment passes!

data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (testigo) y Kili (protagonista del choque).
data.script: Oliver: News flash! Kili has just crashed into the kitchen window. … Oliver: He's fine! He has already eaten three biscuits to feel better. … Oliver: The mail has arrived safely: two letters and one big yellow parcel. … Oliver: We haven't opened the parcel yet — it's for Ingrid. … Oliver: Wait… Ingrid has just come in! She's opening it… … Oliver: It's a new flag for the expedition! Blue, with a silver star. … Oliver: Kili has already forgotten the crash. He's flying loops around the flag!

Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
